summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands on experience building and fine tuning transformer models in PyTorch, from a from scratch GPT-2 style language model to fine tuning a pretrained document understanding transformer via HuggingFace. Background spans custom tokenization pipelines, multilingual speech and text processing, and rigorous model evaluation across benchmark metrics including perplexity, word error rate, and accuracy. Comfortable working independently and across multidisciplinary research teams to define a problem, design an experiment, and report results.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained segmentation models across three backbone architectures; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, defining the research approach and restructuring task distribution to deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed and iteratively evaluated a custom signal processing algorithm, improving reconstruction quality (PSNR) from 65 to 86 through successive rounds of experimentation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with an 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and a 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python.
Achieved 15% WER on a Hindi-English (code-switched, multilingual) dataset via optimized tokenization.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC industry-standard evaluation sets; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase.
Evaluated trade-offs between model efficiency and task performance under deployment constraints.
